chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 332 – Li Huowang Faces Tuoba Danqing’s Probe Under the Feast Lights
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang names the Black Tai Sui 'Li Sui' and forges a pact. Later, a feast with Tuoba Danqing becomes a psychological battlefield when the mask demands an answer.
og_title: The Feast: A Game of Inner Alliances and Outer Masks
og_description: In this tense chapter, Li Huowang formalizes his bond with the Black Tai Sui and then faces a probing interrogation from Tuoba Danqing over dinner.
twitter_title: Ch 332 of Dao Gui Yi Xian: The Mask Slips
twitter_description: Li Huowang names his parasite, then uses it to bluff his way through a dangerous dinner with Tuoba Danqing. A brilliant, disgusting save.

lore_anchors.definition: A folk term for a person who lives into miserable old age without achieving immortality, becoming a blind, malformed creature. In the Dao-Twisted World, cultivators who force their lifespans past 120 with elixirs inevitably become this.
A pill that extends a cultivator's lifespan. It loses effectiveness past the age of 120, and forced use without dispelling inner obsession will turn the user into a Renxiao.
A state of existential confusion. In the Dao-Twisted World, the Bewilderment of a Heart-Element is considered the purest and most effective means of dispelling obsession.
A rank within the Supervisory Heavenly Office. Reaching this rank signals official advancement and grants the holder access to the Office's internal trading system.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Renxiao' that Tuoba Danqing describes?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a person who lived past 120 years without becoming immortal. Forcibly extending their life with elixirs corrupts their obsession into a physical deformity, turning them into a blind, hairy monster.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang decide to show the tentacles under his mask?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Tuoba Danqing was testing him. Instead of dodging the question, Li Huowang weaponizes his own body horror as a misdirect—presenting the Black Tai Sui as a freakish but honest truth to shut down further scrutiny.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the 'Ren Wu' promotion mean for Li Huowang?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Ren Wu rank grants him official access to the Office's internal economy, allowing him to trade Office-earned Yang Life Elixirs for rare artifacts. It also signals a higher level of trust (and scrutiny) from his superiors.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Tuoba Danqing bring up the Heart-Element method for dispelling obsession?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a deliberate trap. He knows a Heart-Element is a rare and dangerous secret. Mentioning it within Li Huowang's hearing is a test to see if his "Brother Er" reacts with recognition or alarm.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Bewilderment of a Heart-Element'?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the purest form of existential confusion, believed to be capable of overwriting a cultivator's stubborn obsession (执念). It is considered the simplest and best method to prevent a cultivator from becoming a Renxiao after forcing life extension past 120.
